purpose: Discover, resolve, preflight and execute bounded multi-hand creative plans against the shared deterministic Creative Hands body, including quality/budget-aware planning for registered proven creation profiles, without making AI the owner of those capabilities.

properties.mode: summary, discover, plan, execute, adaptive-plan or adaptive-execute
properties.goal: caller goal; ordinary V1 discovery remains non-authorizing, while adaptive modes may match it only to an installed deterministic quality profile
properties.quality: optional numeric 0..1 quality depth or a known convenience alias for adaptive modes
properties.machine: optional bounded resource policy: max steps/work/state, observed work throughput, time budget, concurrency, and explicit allow_quality_degrade
properties.profile_id: optional exact installed adaptive quality profile id
properties.state: optional canonical candidate-state values available to plan steps
properties.steps: bounded explicit DAG steps using hand_id, recipe_id or a uniquely resolvable selector
properties.expose: optional named references to return alongside final candidate state

contains: adaptive requested-versus-realized quality evidence when used
machine-budget estimates and dependency-derived schedule groups
compiled dependency order and exact selected operation ids
per-step input/output digests and PASS receipts
candidate final-state digest on successful execution
explicit failure/HOLD without mutating supplied canonical state

relationships: routes through PlatformHands.creativeHands rather than duplicating creative implementations
lets human code, deterministic recipes and AI-proposed plans use the same underlying hand body
lets registered proven quality profiles deterministically derive bounded plans from goal + requested quality + machine policy
keeps unknown goals, ambiguous profile selection, missing required hands and unaccepted quality degradation on HOLD
limitations: Adaptive planning is profile-bounded, not universal prose synthesis. Wave 13 initially installs only the creation profile learned from the verified armored-crate gauntlet; unknown goals HOLD instead of receiving invented plans.

Numeric quality is continuous, but available operation families still create real stage boundaries. Requested and realized quality are reported separately and quality degradation requires explicit allow_quality_degrade=true.

The scheduler derives dependency-safe concurrency groups and a theoretical parallel work floor, but Wave 13 still executes through the existing serial Creative Flow runtime. It does not claim parallel speedup until a worker runtime exists.
A time budget requires an explicit observed work_units_per_ms calibration. Without it, time-bounded adaptive planning returns HOLD_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED rather than guessing hardware speed.

Compatibility preflight proves plan structure, exact operation existence, dependencies and state-reference availability; individual hand implementations remain authoritative for their own schema and parameter validation at execution.
Execution is an in-memory candidate transaction. It does not persist final creative state to a project file or machine canon by itself.
The local Node runtime used by Platform Hands must be available. No network access is required.
Maximum explicit flow length remains 128 steps and maximum encoded request size remains 64 MiB.

truth.basis: Requested quality, realized quality, profile identity, exact selected hands, budget estimates, missing operations, schedule groups, plan digest and execution receipts remain inspectable; unsupported or under-resourced work holds instead of being narrated as achieved.

agency.basis: Adaptive execution requires an explicit adaptive-execute request. Resource-driven quality degradation is off by default and must be explicitly allowed by the caller; AI has no hidden execution path or ownership of the hands.

continuity.basis: The supplied canonical state is cloned into candidate state and is not mutated by the flow runtime; failed or held adaptive plans return evidence rather than partially committing state.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Quality plans are bounded by exact installed profiles, resource ceilings and required capabilities before execution. Missing machine-throughput calibration holds, and planned concurrency is not mislabeled as executed parallel work.
